top_signals.title: Bank of England announces the four animals that will feature on our next series of banknotes
top_signals.summary: The Atlantic puffin, barn owl, buff-tailed bumblebee and European hedgehog will represent UK wildlife and feature as the central images on our next series of banknotes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Ransomware recovery CEO charged over secret ransom payments
top_signals.summary: The owner of ransomware remediation company MonsterCloud has been charged with allegedly defrauding ransomware victims by secretly paying their attackers for decryptors while claiming to use proprietary technology to recover encrypted data. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Drivers set to save as petrol prices launch on Google Maps
top_signals.summary: Drivers to save at the pump as near real-time petrol and diesel prices are included on Google Maps for the first time.
